- Max Müller was born on 6 December 1823 and died on 28 October 1900.
- Rajendralal Mitra was born on 15 February 1824 and died on 26 July 1891.
- Max Müller was a German-born philologist and Orientalist who lived and studied in Britain for most of his life.
- Max Müller wrote both scholarly and popular works on Indology.
- Rajendralal Mitra was the first modern Indologist of Indian origin and a key figure in the Bengal Renaissance.
- Heinrich Zimmer was the most important German scholar in Indian Philology after Max Müller.
- Transtheism is a term coined by either Paul Tillich or Heinrich Zimmer for a religious philosophy that is neither theistic nor atheistic, but beyond both.
